title: Sequin Off-the-shoulder Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Shimmer and shine in this stunning off-the-shoulder evening dress! Adorned with dazzling sequins, it features elegant sleeves and a flattering silhouette, perfect for making a glamorous entrance at any formal event.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Off-the-shoulder sleeve.


Closure: Side zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequins.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
